== Notes ==
* This is one of the skills capable of resurrecting a character with 1 health, such as a [[55 Monk]] or a [[Blood is Power]] [[Necromancer]] that has too much [[Death Penalty]].
* This skill makes sounds like light bells or chimes when casting.
